sql: WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Iris Forge') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, day, SUM(units) AS units FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Iris Forge') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, AVG(available) AS availability, COUNT(available) AS recorded,
            COUNT(*) AS panel_rows, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN switched THEN units END) AS switched_units
            FROM (SELECT *, MIN(available) FILTER (WHERE period = 0) OVER (PARTITION BY sku,region) = 1
              AND MAX(available) FILTER (WHERE period = 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sku,region) = 0 AS switched
              FROM panel) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
